Family: polymer

Habitable: True
Issue: flammability
Application: Velcro is used to restrain SL-J Stowage Hardware, such as bags, pouches, containers and instruments, during the course of the experiment. The stowage items that have velcro, contain patches of approximately 1 to 2 square inches; in a few cases, there are several patches on one item that add up to 3 to 4 square inches.This material was flown on SL-3 and is scheduled to fly on SLS-1, see attached MUAS. Its continue use on SL-J is requested.

Category: I
Determination: APPROVED
Rationale: The SL-J Stowage Hardware will remain in containers and/or lockers. Only a few items will be out of their containers for short periods of time. There are no ignition sources within the enclosed containers nor in the area of planned activities. We recommend acceptance of this material for the SL-J flight.

Application: Diallyl Phthalate per MIL-M-14 SGD-F is a molding compound used for the body in connectors per MIL-C-55302. This material is not listed in MSFC-HDBK-527. It is also used in connectors per MIL-C-55308. Molding compound MIL-M-14 GDI-30F, Item 05196 in MSFC-HDBK-527, is rated A for flammability and A for TVS (see attached test report). These two materials, SGD-F and GDI-30F, are similar except for the length of the glass fiber.

Based on this torque valve, the benign environment that the valve is exposed to, and that the valve is nickel plated. The use of this valve as stated is considered acceptable
